title: People
description: One identity per person who appears in claims under more than one name or login (a mailing list name and a GitHub login, say). Claims use `name`; extractors map aliases to it. Names and public handles only, never email addresses.

aliases.description: Other names and logins the same person uses. Matched case-insensitively.

group.description: Stakeholder group for consensus pages (Who has spoken). Set only when a public source shows the role; most people have none.
